scope: Read-only metadata source views, reviewed against ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 14.3.2/14.3.3 Tables 347-349, 7.7.2 and 14.9.2. Text strings use the shared 7.9.2 decoder. XML/schema parsing, metadata writes, date validation and Info/XMP reconciliation are outside this slice.

review.rule: Keep Info and metadata streams separate. Standard Info text fields are decoded text strings; Trapped is a name, with Unknown as its default. Metadata entries reference streams with Type Metadata and Subtype XML. Retrieval leaves XML bytes inert and preserves stream identity.
review.verdict: Primary clauses reviewed. Independent populated, absent/null/empty, Unicode, compressed packet, source identity, malformed/cyclic and limit controls authored; hosted verification pending.

requirements.gaps: Date strings and language tags are preserved without semantic validation. XML/XMP parsing/schema validation, Info/XMP reconciliation, conditional PieceInfo/ModDate validation, writes and CLI/host/viewer operations remain open.
